Shared with every agent: your role, priorities, and rules.
The agents read this to know who they talk to.
Use Tucano on an iPhone with your account here: your DMs, your approvals and the questions agents ask you.
Manage workspace access and roles. Each person’s DMs remain private.
Workspace activity. Private DM content is excluded.
Export agents, skills, channels, and routines as Markdown, without credentials or chats. Import OpenBot or Grok Bot agents with connectors and search off.
Export everything from Workspace › Backups in the desktop app. Restore replaces agents, chats, memory, Wiki, and files. A .db backup restores only the database.
Back up before deleting data. Automatic backups retain the last 7 daily copies.
Allow 1–10 agent replies before waiting for you.
Stop after no text or completed tools. Work that shows progress continues.
Default approval rules for all agents; override them on each agent’s page. Reading never needs approval.
After reading external content, sending, publishing, paying, deleting, and risky clicks need approval, even if a rule allows them.
Pause at the limit and ask you whether to continue.
For agents without a monthly limit, percentages use a base of 10 million tokens.
Routines require Tucano to keep running, even with its window closed.
Defer routines and triggers until quiet hours end. Direct messages still get replies.
Change each agent’s model or apply one to several at once. Applies to future replies; replies already running continue as they are.
Switching runtimes uses the default login. The fallback model stays unchanged.
Bulk changes include selected agents outside the search. Archived agents are included only when the option above is checked.
Run agents through your existing plans, gateway, or providers. Tucano does not access or store harness credentials.
